KeyValueStorage::ResetKey
(see [SWS_PER_00477]),
ara::per::Rese-
tAllFiles
(see [SWS_PER_00478]), or
ara::per::FileStorage::ResetFile
(see [SWS_PER_00479]) to reset the corrupted item to the initial state according to
the current
manifest
.
The
application
may want to monitor its
storages
for any problem detected by
redundancy
, even if
Persistency
is able to recover by itself. This might be required
to e.g. get an early indication of hardware problems or for safety critical
applica-
tions
. This monitoring is supported by
Persistency
, which will trigger a callback
function of the
application
in case of any problems with the
storages
. To activate
this monitoring, the
application
has to register that callback function using
ara::
per::RegisterRecoveryReportCallback
.
